name: MySQL
description: Oracle MySQL 官方服务端（Alpine 仓库不提供，故不在此支持）
note: 与 MariaDB 二选一：同一台机器上同时装两套 MySQL 系服务端会互相抢 3306 端口与 /var/lib/mysql

actions.label: 服务状态
actions.command:
unit=""
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for u in 'mysql' 'mysqld'; do
    if systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
  for u in 'mysql' 'mysqld'; do
    if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$u" ]; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
[ -n "$unit" ] || unit='mysql'
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl cat "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl status "$unit" --no-pager
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rc-service "$unit" status
else
  echo '未找到服务单元：mysql / mysqld'
  exit 1
fi

actions.label: 最近日志
actions.command:
unit=""
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for u in 'mysql' 'mysqld'; do
    if systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
  for u in 'mysql' 'mysqld'; do
    if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$u" ]; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
[ -n "$unit" ] || unit='mysql'
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  journalctl -u "$unit" -n 80 --no-pager
else
  echo '该主机没有 journalctl，请到系统日志窗口查看 mysql / mysqld'
fi

actions.label: 启动服务
actions.confirm: 启动后服务会立即对外提供能力。
actions.command:
unit=""
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for u in 'mysql' 'mysqld'; do
    if systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
  for u in 'mysql' 'mysqld'; do
    if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$u" ]; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
[ -n "$unit" ] || unit='mysql'
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl cat "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl start "$unit"
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rc-service "$unit" start
else
  echo '未找到服务单元：mysql / mysqld'
  exit 1
fi

actions.command:
unit=""
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then

actions.command:
unit=""

  for u in 'mysql' 'mysqld'; do
    if systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then unit="$u"; break; fi

    if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$u" ]; then unit="$u"; break; fi
